timing: Declared after the external-marker baseline, its sensitivities and the epoch-20 SAE readiness check, before inspecting any direct full-data PCA outcome. Exploratory continuation, not an independent prospective comparison.
question: Can ordinary signed PCA features, without an SAE, recover named-program associations on the same Norman data? This cannot establish a universal ranking or an SAE advantage.
input: Identical count-conserving unique input and load_perturbseq preprocessing as the primary SAE: all 111445 cells, all-gene normalize_total(10000), log1p, top4000 HVGs plus tested targets and external markers (observed4081 genes).

fit.population: all cells, no perturbation identities used
fit.feature_orientations: Both +PC and -PC; retain signed scores without rectification. Both orientations count in the annotation search, so selection is invariant to arbitrary PCA signs.
fit.resource_policy: One CPU thread while the primary SAE continues. No rank or solver tuning after outcomes.

annotation: The existing seed0 within-gemgroup split supplies5926 discovery and5929 inference controls. Gene associations and feature selection use discovery controls only; top50 genes, minimum3 marker symbols present, eligible orientation positive in>=50 discovery controls, Bonferroni over all eligible orientations, match alpha.05. This is a diagnostic annotation gate, not a calibrated gene-exchangeability claim. Marker presence differs from the direct score's detection rule.
association: One-sided gemgroup-stratified, tie-corrected Mann-Whitney against inference controls, all9panels x all105single perturbations, joint BH945 including no-matchp1, q<.05 and AUC>=.55. Unlike historical within-program correction, the full family is retained. No target-omission sensitivity is implied: a PCA score is not an average of listed markers.
identity: Same999 within-gemgroup identity permutations, Holm9, no-matchp1. Controls fixed; association-selected perturbations do not select the feature. Rank heterogeneity can reflect generic severity or other confounding.
comparison_limits: 64 signed axes and2048 SAE features have unequal capacity/search spaces. Their annotation and heldout-control procedures also differ from the original SAE analysis. Report all panels and complete effects; no inference of superiority from response counts, p-values, seed agreement or unmatched panels. No NMF completion or independent biological replication is asserted.
archive: Save fitted components/mean/variance outside Git; compact all-panel results, full945comparisons, exact parameters, source/input/model hashes, control split and versions in Git. Refuse existing outputs.
